2: 
3: Ratificada por el fundador el 22 de octubre de 2026 para corregir las gift cards y evitar entregas exclusivamente tipográficas.
4: 
5: ## Alcance obligatorio
6: 
7: Aplica a toda pieza visual comercial de Studio, Signature, Corp, Pop! y Biometrics: gift cards, pases, anuncios, publicaciones, portadas, folletos, presentaciones y materiales promocionales. No se entregan piezas compuestas única y exclusivamente por texto, logotipos, líneas, fondos o figuras decorativas. Un logo no sustituye una fotografía.
8: 
9: Cada pieza debe integrar una fotografía protagonista, pertinente al servicio y con calidad suficiente para su formato final. El texto debe ser breve y legible y no tapar al sujeto, producto ni composición. Deben preservarse la identidad oficial, el encuadre completo y las proporciones originales; no cortar cabeza, manos, extremidades ni calzado para adaptar una foto a una plantilla.
10: 
11: ## Selección de fotografías
12: 
13: La fuente se elige según la instrucción vigente del fundador. Para la reformulación de las 20 gift cards de octubre de 2026: utilizar fotografías de banco de Pexels o Canva; Picsart es la alternativa de producción si Canva no está disponible. No usar fotografías del portafolio ni imágenes de clientes en estas tarjetas. Registrar la procedencia de las imágenes y verificar su licencia aplicable. No presentar imágenes de banco como trabajos realizados por CAPTOORA.
14: 
15: ## Control antes de entregar
16: 
17: 1. Cada pieza contiene una fotografía visible y protagonista.
18: 2. Se respeta el encuadre completo, sin deformación ni recortes de extremidades.
19: 3. El texto no invade al sujeto ni al producto y se lee en celular.
20: 4. La fuente de la fotografía corresponde a la instrucción del encargo.
21: 5. Se ha revisado el archivo exportado, no solo la plantilla.
22: 
23: Una pieza que no cumpla debe corregirse antes de entregarse. Esta regla es un criterio interno de marca, no una disposición legal ni una sanción jurídica.

25: ## Custodia de las fotos de sesión
26:

28: 
29: Queda estrictamente prohibido que las fotografías de las sesiones de Captoora toquen el almacenamiento interno de sus computadoras. Eso incluye el SSD, el iMac y cualquier disco interno.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es-MX">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>CAPTOORA STUDIO · Campaña Navidad 2026 // Command Center</title>
  <meta name="description" content="Centro de Mando Operativo y de Marketing para la Campaña Navideña 2026 de Captoora Studio: Preventa Flash, 5 Submarcas, Matriz de 40 Posts y Guiones de Video 15s.">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cinzel:wght@500;700;900&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;700&family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg: #040507;
      --card-bg: #090b10;
      --card-inner: #0f131a;
      --border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      --border-focus: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.4);
      --gold: #d4af37;
      --gold-glow: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.25);
      --emerald: #10b981;
      --emerald-glow: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2);
      --cyan: #00f0ff;
      --cyan-glow: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.2);
      --crimson: #ef4444;
      --text: #f8fafc;
      --text-muted: #94a3b8;
      --text-dim: #64748b;
    }

    * {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      box-sizing: border-box;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }

    body {
      background-color: var(--bg);
      color: var(--text);
      font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
      line-height: 1.5;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      padding-bottom: 90px;
    }

    /* TOP COMMAND DOCK */
    .command-dock {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 1000;
      background: rgba(4, 5, 7, 0.94);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 14px 28px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .brand-id {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      text-decoration: none;
      color: inherit;
    }

    .brand-mark {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1e293b, #0f172a);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--gold);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
    }

    .brand-name {
      font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      color: #fff;
    }

    .brand-sub {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      color: var(--gold);
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    }

    .dock-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .dock-pill {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      padding: 6px 12px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      text-decoration: none;
      font-weight: 600;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .pill-preventa {
      background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15);
      border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4);
      color: #fca5a5;
    }

    .pill-wa {
      background: #25d366;
      color: #000;
      border: 1px solid #25d366;
    }
    .pill-wa:hover {
      background: #1eb956;
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .pill-pdf {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--text);
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .pill-pdf:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
    }

    /* CONTAINER */
    .container {
      max-width: 1320px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
    }

    /* HERO & VALUE ARCHITECTURE */
    .campaign-hero {
      padding: 60px 0 40px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .hero-eyebrow {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.25em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--gold);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 4px 14px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.08);
      border: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.2);
    }

    .hero-title {
      font-family: 'Cinzel', serif;
      font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 5.5vw, 4.4rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.1;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    }

    .hero-title span {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff 20%, var(--gold) 100%);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    }

    .hero-subtitle {
      max-width: 820px;
      margin: 0 auto 36px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* COUNTDOWN & NUMBERS BANNER */
    .offer-banner {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #0d1118 0%, #080a0f 100%);
      border: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.25);
      border-radius: 20px;
      padding: 28px 32px;
      margin-bottom: 50px;
      box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 2fr;
      gap: 32px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .offer-banner {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }

    .countdown-box {
      border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding-right: 24px;
      text-align: left;
    }

    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .countdown-box {
        border-right: none;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        padding-right: 0;
        padding-bottom: 24px;
        text-align: center;
      }
    }

    .countdown-label {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--crimson);
      letter-spacing: 0.15em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .countdown-timer {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-top: 10px;
    }
    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .countdown-timer {
        justify-content: center;
      }
    }

    .timer-unit {
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 10px 14px;
      min-width: 68px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .timer-num {
      font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1.8rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #fff;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .timer-tag {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }

    /* PRICING SPLIT */
    .pricing-split {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
      text-align: center;
    }
    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      .pricing-split {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }

    .price-pill {
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 14px;
      padding: 14px;
    }

    .price-pill.highlight {
      border-color: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4);
      background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.06);
    }

    .pill-header {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    }

    .price-amount {
      font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1.7rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #fff;
      margin: 4px 0;
    }

    .price-pill.highlight .price-amount {
      color: var(--emerald);
    }

    .pill-note {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    /* SECTION HEADERS */
    .section-head {
      margin: 50px 0 28px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      justify-content: space-between;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 16px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .section-title {
      font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1.8rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #fff;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }

    .section-desc {
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      max-width: 640px;
    }

    /* TABS */
    .nav-tabs {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
      padding: 4px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      overflow-x: auto;
    }

    .tab-btn {
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 8px 18px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .tab-btn.active {
      background: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.15);
      color: var(--gold);
      border: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.3);
    }

    /* 5 SUB-BRANDS VISUAL GRID (LEY VISUAL: ZERO CROP, 100% FULL-FRAME) */
    .multiverse-showcase {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(360px, 1fr));
      gap: 28px;
    }

    .subbrand-card {
      background: var(--card-bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 20px;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
      box-shadow: 0 15px 35px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    }

    .subbrand-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 45px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
    }

    /* FOTO PROTOCOL: FULL FRAME WITHOUT CROP */
    .card-photo-wrap {
      width: 100%;
      background: #000;
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .card-photo-wrap img {
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      display: block;
      object-fit: contain;
      aspect-ratio: 3 / 4;
      max-height: 480px;
    }

    .photo-badge {
      position: absolute;
      top: 14px;
      left: 14px;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
      border-radius: 6px;
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 0.68rem;
      padding: 4px 8px;
      color: #fff;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .photo-badge-zero {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 14px;
      right: 14px;
      background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.9);
      color: #000;
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 3px 8px;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }

    .card-content {
      padding: 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      flex-grow: 1;
    }

    .brand-eyebrow {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .card-title {
      font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1.4rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #fff;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .card-hook {
      font-size: 0.92rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      line-height: 1.5;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      flex-grow: 1;
    }

    .card-features {
      list-style: none;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      background: var(--card-inner);
      padding: 12px 16px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
    }

    .card-features li {
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .card-features li:last-child {
      margin-bottom: 0;
    }

    .card-actions {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-top: auto;
    }

    .btn-action {
      font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 10px 14px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      text-align: center;
      text-decoration: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 6px;
      border: none;
    }

    .btn-wa-card {
      background: #25d366;
      color: #000;
    }
    .btn-wa-card:hover {
      background: #1eb956;
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .btn-copy-card {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      color: #fff;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .btn-copy-card:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
      border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
    }

    /* COPY & ACCORDION SECTION */
    .posts-stream {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .post-accordion-item {
      background: var(--card-bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 16px;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: border-color 0.2s ease;
    }

    .post-accordion-item.active {
      border-color: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.4);
    }

    .post-header {
      padding: 18px 24px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      cursor: pointer;
      user-select: none;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01);
    }

    .post-header:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
    }

    .post-tagline {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .post-num {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
      padding: 4px 8px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      color: var(--gold);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .post-title-text {
      font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #fff;
    }

    .post-badges {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .badge-format {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      color: var(--cyan);
      background: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.08);
      border: 1px solid rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.2);
      padding: 3px 8px;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }

    .post-content {
      padding: 24px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      background: var(--card-inner);
      display: none;
    }

    .post-accordion-item.active .post-content {
      display: block;
    }

    .caption-box {
      background: #000;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 18px;
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: #e2e8f0;
      white-space: pre-wrap;
      line-height: 1.6;
      max-height: 320px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }

    .caption-toolbar {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    /* MASTER MATRIX TABLE (40 POSTS) */
    .matrix-panel {
      background: var(--card-bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 24px;
    }

    .matrix-controls {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 16px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .matrix-search {
      background: #000;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: #fff;
      font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      padding: 8px 16px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      min-width: 280px;
    }
    .matrix-search:focus {
      outline: none;
      border-color: var(--gold);
    }

    .matrix-table-wrap {
      overflow-x: auto;
    }

    .matrix-table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      text-align: left;
      font-size: 0.82rem;
    }

    .matrix-table th {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      padding: 12px 14px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
    }

    .matrix-table td {
      padding: 12px 14px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    .matrix-table tr:hover td {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
      color: #fff;
    }

    .id-chip {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--gold);
    }

    /* REELS STORYBOARDS (15S) */
    .reels-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(380px, 1fr));
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .reel-card {
      background: var(--card-bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 22px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .reel-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .reel-title {
      font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #fff;
    }

    .reel-time {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;

      if (diff <= 0) {
        document.getElementById('daysNum').innerText = "00";
        document.getElementById('hoursNum').innerText = "00";
        document.getElementById('minsNum').innerText = "00";
        document.getElementById('secsNum').innerText = "00";

      const hours = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
      const minutes = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));

      biometrics: document.getElementById('caption_p5').innerText,
      pop: document.getElementById('caption_p6').innerText
    };

    function copyPreset(brandKey) {
      const copyText = brandCopies[brandKey];
      if (copyText) {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(copyText).then(() => {
          showToast(`✓ Copy de ${brandKey.toUpperCase()} copiado`);
        });
      }
    }

    // FILTER BRANDS
    function filterBrands(category) {
      const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tabs .tab-btn');
      buttons.forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
      event.target.classList.add('active');

      const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.subbrand-card');
      cards.forEach(card => {
        if (category === 'all' || card.getAttribute('data-brand') === category) {
          card.style.display = 'flex';
        } else {
          card.style.display = 'none';
        }
      });
    }

    // SEARCH MATRIX TABLE
    function filterMatrixTable() {
      const input = document.getElementById('matrixSearch').value.toLowerCase();
      const rows = document.querySelectorAll('#matrixTable tbody tr');

      rows.forEach(row => {
        const text = row.innerText.toLowerCase();
        row.style.display = text.includes(input) ? '' : 'none';
      });
    }

### What is `notebooklm-py`?
It is an unofficial, open-source Python API and command-line interface (CLI) for Google NotebookLM (rebranded in some contexts as Gemini Notebook)[2][1][3]. It enables programmatic access to features that aren't typically exposed via the standard web UI[2][4].

### Key Features:
* **Python API & CLI:** Automate workflows, manage notebooks, and bulk-import sources (URLs, PDFs, YouTube videos, Google Drive) via code or shell scripts[1].
* **Content Generation:** Programmatically generate and download Audio Overviews (podcasts), slide decks, reports, quizzes, and flashcards[1][3][5].
* **AI Agent Integration:** Supports native agent skills and MCP (Model Context Protocol) setups for coding assistants like Claude Code, Codex, and others[2][6][3][7].

### Quick Installation:
```bash
# Basic installation
pip install notebooklm-py

# With browser login support (required for initial authentication via Playwright)
pip install "notebooklm-py[browser]"
playwright install chromium
```
*(Note: Because this relies on unofficial, undocumented Google endpoints and browser session cookies, it is intended primarily for personal research, prototyping, and automation, and is subject to unexpected changes if Google updates its backend[1][8].)*

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json
import re
import shutil
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

CONV_ID = "f71b5fab-a0c2-40f3-aa5e-05a09b19ab67"
BRAIN_LOGS = Path(f"/Users/imac/.gemini/antigravity/brain/{CONV_ID}/.system_generated/logs")
FULL_JSONL = BRAIN_LOGS / "transcript_full.jsonl"
COMPACT_JSONL = BRAIN_LOGS / "transcript.jsonl"

MTY_TZ = timezone(timedelta(hours=-6))


def fmt_ts(iso_str: str) -> str:
    if not iso_str:
        return "N/A"
    try:
        dt = datetime.fromisoformat(iso_str.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
        mty = dt.astimezone(MTY_TZ)
        return f"{mty.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')} (America/Monterrey) / {dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%SZ')}"
    except Exception:
        return iso_str


def load_steps(path: Path):
    steps = []
    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for line in f:
            if line.strip():
                steps.append(json.loads(line))
    return steps


def extract_user_parts(raw: str):
    req_match = re.search(r"<USER_REQUEST>\s*(.*?)\s*</USER_REQUEST>", raw, re.S)
    user_text = req_match.group(1) if req_match else raw
    sys_msgs = re.findall(r"<SYSTEM_MESSAGE>\s*(.*?)\s*</SYSTEM_MESSAGE>", raw, re.S)
    return user_text, sys_msgs


def export_all(target_dir: Path):
    target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    raw_dir = target_dir / "raw"
    raw_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    # 1. Verbatim raw Antigravity JSONL copies
    shutil.copy2(FULL_JSONL, raw_dir / "transcript_full.jsonl")
    shutil.copy2(COMPACT_JSONL, raw_dir / "transcript.jsonl")

    steps = load_steps(FULL_JSONL)

    # 2. Verbatim Dialogue Markdown (every single user prompt & assistant reply word-for-word)
    dlg_lines = [
        "# Copia Literal de Conversación Completa (Antigravity)",
        "",
        f"- **Conversation ID:** `{CONV_ID}`",
        "- **Workspace origen:** `iMac 2015` (`/Users/imac/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Desktop/Projects/CAPTOORA.STUDIO`)",
        f"- **Total de pasos registrados en `transcript_full.jsonl` al exportar:** `{len(steps)}`",
        f"- **Fecha de exportación:** `{datetime.now(MTY_TZ).strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')} (America/Monterrey)`",
        "",
        "> **Nota de fidelidad:** Este archivo reproduce **palabra por palabra** cada mensaje enviado por el usuario y cada respuesta emitida por el asistente durante toda la conversación, en orden cronológico estricto. El JSONL técnico completo (incluyendo pensamientos internos, llamadas a herramientas y salidas de terminal) se encuentra en `raw/transcript_full.jsonl` y resumido en `CONVERSACION_BITACORA_TECNICA_COMPLETA.md`.",
        "",
        "---",
        "",
    ]

    turn_num = 0
    for s in steps:
        stype = s.get("type")
        idx = s.get("step_index")
        ts = fmt_ts(s.get("created_at", ""))
        content = s.get("content") or ""

        if stype == "USER_INPUT":
            turn_num += 1
            user_text, sys_msgs = extract_user_parts(content)
            dlg_lines.append(f"## Turno {turn_num} · USUARIO (Step `{idx}`)")
            dlg_lines.append(f"**Fecha:** {ts}")
            dlg_lines.append("")
            dlg_lines.append(user_text)
            dlg_lines.append("")
            if sys_msgs:
                dlg_lines.append("<details>")
                dlg_lines.append("<summary>Notificaciones del sistema adjuntas en este turno</summary>")
                dlg_lines.append("")
                for sm in sys_msgs:
                    dlg_lines.append("```text")
                    dlg_lines.append(sm.strip())
                    dlg_lines.append("```")
                dlg_lines.append("</details>")
                dlg_lines.append("")
            dlg_lines.append("---")
            dlg_lines.append("")

        elif stype == "PLANNER_RESPONSE" and content.strip():
            turn_num += 1
            dlg_lines.append(f"## Turno {turn_num} · ASISTENTE (Step `{idx}`)")
            dlg_lines.append(f"**Fecha:** {ts}")
            dlg_lines.append("")
            dlg_lines.append(content)
            dlg_lines.append("")
            dlg_lines.append("---")
            dlg_lines.append("")

    (target_dir / "CONVERSACION_DIALOGO_LITERAL.md").write_text("\n".join(dlg_lines), encoding="utf-8")

    # 3. Complete Technical Trace (all steps, tool calls, created/edited files, commands)
    tech_lines = [
        "# Bitácora Técnica Completa Paso a Paso",
        "",
        f"- **Conversation ID:** `{CONV_ID}`",
        f"- **Total steps:** `{len(steps)}`",
        "",
        "Este documento lista **todos los pasos** (usuario, respuestas, llamadas a herramientas, archivos escritos/modificados y comandos ejecutados). Para texto enorme de salida de herramientas, se muestra el inicio y la referencia al paso en `raw/transcript_full.jsonl`.",
        "",
        "---",
        "",
    ]

    for s in steps:
        idx = s.get("step_index")
        stype = s.get("type")
        src = s.get("source")
        ts = fmt_ts(s.get("created_at", ""))
        content = s.get("content") or ""
        tcalls = s.get("tool_calls") or []
        thinking = s.get("thinking") or ""

        if stype == "USER_INPUT":
            user_text, _ = extract_user_parts(content)
            tech_lines.append(f"### Step {idx} · `{stype}` (`{src}`) · {ts}")
            tech_lines.append("")
            tech_lines.append(user_text)
            tech_lines.append("")
        elif stype == "PLANNER_RESPONSE":
            tech_lines.append(f"### Step {idx} · `{stype}` (`{src}`) · {ts}")
            if tcalls:
                tech_lines.append("")
                tech_lines.append("**Tool Calls:**")
                for tc in tcalls:
                    name = tc.get("name")
                    args = tc.get("args") or {}
                    summary_args = {}
                    if isinstance(args, dict):
                        for k, v in args.items():
                            sv = str(v)
                            if len(sv) > 260:
                                summary_args[k] = sv[:260] + f"... [+{len(sv)-260} chars en raw/transcript_full.jsonl]"
                            else:
                                summary_args[k] = v
                    else:
                        summary_args = args
                    tech_lines.append(f"- `{name}`: `{json.dumps(summary_args, ensure_ascii=False)}`")
            if content.strip():
                tech_lines.append("")
                tech_lines.append("**Respuesta al usuario:**")
                tech_lines.append("")
                tech_lines.append(content)
            elif thinking.strip():
                snip = thinking.strip().replace("\n", " ")[:240]
                tech_lines.append("")
                tech_lines.append(f"*Razonamiento interno (extracto):* {snip}...")
            tech_lines.append("")
        elif stype in ("GENERIC", "ERROR_MESSAGE", "SYSTEM_MESSAGE"):
            first_lines = "\n".join(content.splitlines()[:18])
            if len(content) > 1200:
                first_lines = content[:1200] + f"\n... [truncado en vista Markdown; completo ({len(content)} chars) en raw/transcript_full.jsonl]"
            tech_lines.append(f"<details><summary>Step {idx} · {stype} ({ts}) · {len(content)} chars</summary>")
            tech_lines.append("")
            tech_lines.append("```text")
            tech_lines.append(first_lines.replace("```", "'''"))
            tech_lines.append("```")
            tech_lines.append("</details>")
            tech_lines.append("")

    (target_dir / "CONVERSACION_BITACORA_TECNICA_COMPLETA.md").write_text("\n".join(tech_lines), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"Exported {len(steps)} steps and {turn_num} dialogue turns to {target_dir}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys
    out = Path(sys.argv[1])
    export_all(out)
